```{=html}
<style>
.w103-num { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w103-num .w103-q { margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
.w103-num .w103-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w103-num .w103-in {
  padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; width: 8em; font: inherit; text-align: right;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w103-num .w103-in.w103-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w103-num .w103-in.w103-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w103-num .w103-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w103-num .w103-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w103-num .w103-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w103-num .w103-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w103-num .w103-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w103-num .w103-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w103-num .w103-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="iw w103-num" id="w103">
  <div class="w103-q">A breach of the Nextcloud VM is discovered and forensics begins
  with the Azure Activity Log, which is enabled by default. For how many days is it
  retained - and after which any management-plane action not routed elsewhere is gone?</div>
  <div class="w103-row">
    <input type="number" class="w103-in" aria-label="number of days"
           step="any" placeholder="…"> <span>days</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w103-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w103-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w103-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w103-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w103-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w103-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w103-expl iw-expl" hidden>The Azure Activity Log is enabled by default but retained for only ninety days, and an intrusion may be discovered months after it began - which is why security-relevant logs are routed to Log Analytics or longer-term storage rather than left to expire - see <a href="#sec-10-logs-events">the section on logs, events and the content of a log line</a>.</div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w103');
  const inp = root.querySelector('.w103-in');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w103-msg');
  const ANSWER = 90, TOL = 0.5;
  function clearMarks() {
    inp.classList.remove('w103-right', 'w103-wrong');
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w103-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function check() {
    clearMarks();
    const v = parseFloat(inp.value);
    if (inp.value.trim() === '' || isNaN(v)) { msg.textContent = 'Enter a number of days first.'; return; }
    if (Math.abs(v - ANSWER) < TOL) {
      inp.classList.add('w103-right');
      msg.textContent = '✓ Correct - which is why an intrusion discovered months later needs the logs routed to longer-term storage.';
      msg.classList.add('ok');
    } else {
      inp.classList.add('w103-wrong');
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not the default retention the chapter gives - try again.';
      msg.classList.add('bad');
    }
  }
  inp.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
  inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') check(); });
  root.querySelector('.w103-check').addEventListener('click', check);
  root.querySelector('.w103-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelector('.w103-expl').hidden = true;
    inp.value = ''; clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w103-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    inp.value = String(ANSWER);
    inp.classList.add('w103-right');
    root.querySelector('.w103-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.classList.add('ok');
  });
})();
</script>
```
